Corrections, completed searches, new direct evidence and changes in requirements should reopen the relevant answer.


<a id="universal-faqs"></a>
## Cocoa FAQs

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-cocoa-and-chocolate" data-anchor="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-cocoa-and-chocolate" data-question="What heavy metals are found in cocoa and chocolate?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What heavy metals are found in cocoa and chocolate?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Cadmium is the metal found at levels that matter most, followed by lead; cocoa is also high in nickel and aluminium.<sup class="cite">[[sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Eileen Abt, Jennifer Fong Sam, Patrick Gray, Lauren Posnick Robin · 2018</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market">Cadmium and Lead in Cocoa Powder and Chocolate Products in the U.S. Market</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Additives &amp; Contaminants: Part B Surveillance</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/efsa2015-nickel-food-water|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">EFSA Panel on Contaminants in the Food Chain (CONTAM) · 2015</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/efsa2015-nickel-food-water">Scientific Opinion on the risks to public health related to the presence of nickel in food and drinking water</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">EFSA Journal 2015;13(2):4002, 202 pp.</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/efsa2015-nickel-food-water">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fechner2019-cocoa-origin-al-cd-exposure|24]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Fechner C, Greiner M, Heseker H, Lindtner O · 2019</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fechner2019-cocoa-origin-al-cd-exposure">Dietary exposure assessment of aluminium and cadmium from cocoa in relation to cocoa origin</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">PLoS ONE</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fechner2019-cocoa-origin-al-cd-exposure">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Arsenic and mercury are usually low or below detection.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|5]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|14]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="how-do-heavy-metals-get-into-cocoa" data-anchor="how-do-heavy-metals-get-into-cocoa" data-question="How do heavy metals get into cocoa?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>How do heavy metals get into cocoa?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Cadmium is taken up from the soil by the roots and is highest where soils are rich in cadmium and acidic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/wade2022-cacao-cadmium-drivers|6]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Wade J, Ac-Pangan M, Favoretto VR, Taylor AJ, Engeseth N, Margenot AJ · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/wade2022-cacao-cadmium-drivers">Drivers of cadmium accumulation in Theobroma cacao L. beans: A quantitative synthesis of soil-plant relationships across the Cacao Belt</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">PLOS ONE</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/wade2022-cacao-cadmium-drivers">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/thomas2023-peru-cacao-cd-distribution|23]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Thomas E, Atkinson R, Zavaleta D, Rodriguez C, Lastra S, Yovera F, Arango K, Pezo A, Aguilar J, Tames M, Ramos A, Cruz W, Cosme R, Espinoza E, Chavez CR, Ladd B · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/thomas2023-peru-cacao-cd-distribution">The distribution of cadmium in soil and cacao beans in Peru</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Science of the Total Environment</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/thomas2023-peru-cacao-cd-distribution">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Lead mostly settles on the bean shell from soil and dust after harvest.<sup class="cite">[[sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahn, Timothy, Chaney, Rufus L., DiBartolomeis, Michael J., Ramtahal, Gideon · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Expert Investigation Related to Cocoa and Chocolate Products: Final Report</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Expert Committee report submitted to As You Sow and the Settling Defendants under a California Proposition 65 Consent Judgment; Project Manager: Eastern Research Group, Inc. (ERG). Final Report dated March 28, 2022 (381 pp., including three technical attachments).</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="is-organic-chocolate-lower-in-heavy-metals" data-anchor="is-organic-chocolate-lower-in-heavy-metals" data-question="Is organic chocolate lower in heavy metals?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Is organic chocolate lower in heavy metals?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Not in the available evidence: in a multi-year US analysis, certified-organic products averaged about 400 µg/kg more cadmium and 20 µg/kg more lead.<sup class="cite">[[sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa|26]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Hands JM, Anderson ML, Cooperman T, Balsky JE, Frame LA · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa">A multi-year heavy metal analysis of 72 dark chocolate and cocoa products in the USA</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Frontiers in Nutrition</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> A German organic milk chocolate pool also had more cadmium than the conventional pool (56 against 16 µg/kg), though that is one pool each.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fechner2022-bfr-meal-hg-cd-pb-ni-germany|17]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Fechner C, Hackethal C, Höpfner T, Dietrich J, Bloch D, Lindtner O, Sarvan I · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fechner2022-bfr-meal-hg-cd-pb-ni-germany">Results of the BfR MEAL Study: In Germany, mercury is mostly contained in fish and seafood while cadmium, lead, and nickel are present in a broad spectrum of foods</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Chemistry: X</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fechner2022-bfr-meal-hg-cd-pb-ni-germany">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="which-types-of-chocolate-have-the-lowest-levels" data-anchor="which-types-of-chocolate-have-the-lowest-levels" data-question="Which types of chocolate have the lowest levels?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Which types of chocolate have the lowest levels?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Milk and white chocolate, because they contain the least cocoa solids.<sup class="cite">[[sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Eileen Abt, Jennifer Fong Sam, Patrick Gray, Lauren Posnick Robin · 2018</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market">Cadmium and Lead in Cocoa Powder and Chocolate Products in the U.S. Market</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Additives &amp; Contaminants: Part B Surveillance</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/kataoka2018-japan-chocolate-cocoa-cadmium|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Kataoka Y, Watanabe T, Hayashi K, Akiyama H · 2018</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kataoka2018-japan-chocolate-cocoa-cadmium">Surveillance of Cadmium Concentration in Chocolate and Cocoa Powder Products Distributed in Japan</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Hygiene and Safety Science</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kataoka2018-japan-chocolate-cocoa-cadmium">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> In the US survey, milk chocolate averaged 60 µg/kg cadmium against 270 µg/kg in dark chocolate and 700 µg/kg in cocoa powder.<sup class="cite">[[sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Eileen Abt, Jennifer Fong Sam, Patrick Gray, Lauren Posnick Robin · 2018</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market">Cadmium and Lead in Cocoa Powder and Chocolate Products in the U.S. Market</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Additives &amp; Contaminants: Part B Surveillance</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="which-growing-regions-produce-cocoa-with-the-lowest-cadmium" data-anchor="which-growing-regions-produce-cocoa-with-the-lowest-cadmium" data-question="Which growing regions produce cocoa with the lowest cadmium?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Which growing regions produce cocoa with the lowest cadmium?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

West African beans measured lowest, with medians of 55 to 90 µg/kg for Nigeria, Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana and Cameroon, against 511 to 892 µg/kg for Ecuador, Peru and Venezuela.<sup class="cite">[[sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahn, Timothy, Chaney, Rufus L., DiBartolomeis, Michael J., Ramtahal, Gideon · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Expert Investigation Related to Cocoa and Chocolate Products: Final Report</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Expert Committee report submitted to As You Sow and the Settling Defendants under a California Proposition 65 Consent Judgment; Project Manager: Eastern Research Group, Inc. (ERG). Final Report dated March 28, 2022 (381 pp., including three technical attachments).</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Ranges within countries are wide, and these origins are not lower in lead.<sup class="cite">[[sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahn, Timothy, Chaney, Rufus L., DiBartolomeis, Michael J., Ramtahal, Gideon · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Expert Investigation Related to Cocoa and Chocolate Products: Final Report</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Expert Committee report submitted to As You Sow and the Settling Defendants under a California Proposition 65 Consent Judgment; Project Manager: Eastern Research Group, Inc. (ERG). Final Report dated March 28, 2022 (381 pp., including three technical attachments).</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/arevalo-gardini2017-peru-cacao-regional-metals|16]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Arévalo-Gardini E, Arévalo-Hernández CO, Baligar VC, He ZL · 2017</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/arevalo-gardini2017-peru-cacao-regional-metals">Heavy metal accumulation in leaves and beans of cacao (Theobroma cacao L.) in major cacao growing regions in Peru</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Science of the Total Environment</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/arevalo-gardini2017-peru-cacao-regional-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="is-cocoa-powder-higher-in-metals-than-chocolate" data-anchor="is-cocoa-powder-higher-in-metals-than-chocolate" data-question="Is cocoa powder higher in metals than chocolate?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Is cocoa powder higher in metals than chocolate?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Yes: cocoa powder is the most concentrated retail form because it is defatted cocoa solids.<sup class="cite">[[sources/oliveira2021-cocoa-beans-cd-pb-brazil-processing|10]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ferreira de Oliveira AP, Milani RF, Efraim P, Morgano MA, Tfouni SAV · 2021</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/oliveira2021-cocoa-beans-cd-pb-brazil-processing">Cd and Pb in cocoa beans: Occurrence and effects of chocolate processing</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Control 119, 107455</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/oliveira2021-cocoa-beans-cd-pb-brazil-processing">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> US cocoa powder averaged 700 µg/kg cadmium and 110 µg/kg lead, against 270 and 30 µg/kg in dark chocolate.<sup class="cite">[[sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Eileen Abt, Jennifer Fong Sam, Patrick Gray, Lauren Posnick Robin · 2018</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market">Cadmium and Lead in Cocoa Powder and Chocolate Products in the U.S. Market</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Additives &amp; Contaminants: Part B Surveillance</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/abt2018-cadmium-lead-cocoa-chocolate-us-market">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-do-the-levels-in-chocolate-mean-for-health" data-anchor="what-do-the-levels-in-chocolate-mean-for-health" data-question="What do the levels in chocolate mean for health?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What do the levels in chocolate mean for health?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Chocolate is a modest source of dietary cadmium, supplying about 4% of European exposure and close to 10% for school-age children.<sup class="cite">[[sources/efsa2012-cadmium-dietary-exposure-europe|12]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Food Safety Authority · 2012</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/efsa2012-cadmium-dietary-exposure-europe">Cadmium dietary exposure in the European population</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">EFSA Journal 2012;10(1):2551</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/efsa2012-cadmium-dietary-exposure-europe">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> JECFA concluded cocoa products are not a major contributor to cadmium exposure, but they matter more for nickel in children and adolescents.<sup class="cite">[[sources/jecfa-91st-cadmium-2022|9]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on Food Additives · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/jecfa-91st-cadmium-2022">Cadmium: dietary exposure assessment</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">WHO Food Additives Series, No. 82 (Safety evaluation of certain contaminants in food, prepared by the 91st meeting of JECFA)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/jecfa-91st-cadmium-2022">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/efsa-nickel-contam-2020|40]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">EFSA Panel on Contaminants in the Food Chain (CONTAM) · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/efsa-nickel-contam-2020">Update of the Risk Assessment of Nickel in Food and Drinking Water</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">EFSA Journal 2020;18(11):6268</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/efsa-nickel-contam-2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="are-there-legal-limits-for-heavy-metals-in-chocolate" data-anchor="are-there-legal-limits-for-heavy-metals-in-chocolate" data-question="Are there legal limits for heavy metals in chocolate?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Are there legal limits for heavy metals in chocolate?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Yes: the EU limits cadmium at 0.10 to 0.80 mg/kg in chocolate by cocoa content and 0.60 mg/kg in cocoa powder, and has limited nickel since July 2025.<sup class="cite">[[sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels|7]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Commission · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/915 of 25 April 2023 on maximum levels for certain contaminants in food and repealing Regulation (EC) No 1881/2006</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Official Journal of the European Union</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/eu-2024-1987-nickel-maximum-levels|27]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Commission · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/eu-2024-1987-nickel-maximum-levels">Commission Regulation (EU) 2024/1987 of 30 July 2024 amending Regulation (EU) 2023/915 as regards maximum levels of nickel in certain foodstuffs</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Official Journal of the European Union, L series, 2024/1987 (31.7.2024)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/eu-2024-1987-nickel-maximum-levels">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Codex sets cadmium at 0.3 to 0.9 mg/kg for chocolate and 2.0 mg/kg for cocoa powder, and MERCOSUR and China also limit lead.<sup class="cite">[[sources/codex-cxs-193-1995|11]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Codex Alimentarius Commission · 1995</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/codex-cxs-193-1995">General Standard for Contaminants and Toxins in Food and Feed (CXS 193-1995)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Codex Alimentarius (Joint FAO/WHO Food Standards Programme)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/codex-cxs-193-1995">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/mercosur2011-gmc-res-12-inorganic-contaminants|38]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">MERCOSUR Grupo Mercado Comun · 2011</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/mercosur2011-gmc-res-12-inorganic-contaminants">MERCOSUR/GMC/RES. No. 12/11: Reglamento Tecnico MERCOSUR sobre Limites Maximos de Contaminantes Inorganicos en Alimentos</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">MERCOSUR/GMC/RES. No. 12/11</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/mercosur2011-gmc-res-12-inorganic-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/usda-fas2023-china-gb-2762-2022-translation|39]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">USDA Foreign Agricultural Service, FAS China Staff (Beijing) · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/usda-fas2023-china-gb-2762-2022-translation">China Releases the Standard for Maximum Levels of Contaminants in Foods (USDA FAS GAIN Report CH2023-0040, unofficial translation of GB 2762-2022)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">USDA Foreign Agricultural Service, Global Agricultural Information Network (GAIN), Report Number CH2023-0040</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/usda-fas2023-china-gb-2762-2022-translation">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="can-processing-reduce-heavy-metals-in-cocoa" data-anchor="can-processing-reduce-heavy-metals-in-cocoa" data-question="Can processing reduce heavy metals in cocoa?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Can processing reduce heavy metals in cocoa?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Cleaning and shelling lower lead: cleaning cut whole-bean lead from 95.2 to 23.2 to 39.7 µg/kg in one factory study.<sup class="cite">[[sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahn, Timothy, Chaney, Rufus L., DiBartolomeis, Michael J., Ramtahal, Gideon · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Expert Investigation Related to Cocoa and Chocolate Products: Final Report</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Expert Committee report submitted to As You Sow and the Settling Defendants under a California Proposition 65 Consent Judgment; Project Manager: Eastern Research Group, Inc. (ERG). Final Report dated March 28, 2022 (381 pp., including three technical attachments).</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Processing does not remove cadmium; it moves it into the cocoa solids, so powder ends up more concentrated than liquor.<sup class="cite">[[sources/oliveira2021-cocoa-beans-cd-pb-brazil-processing|10]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ferreira de Oliveira AP, Milani RF, Efraim P, Morgano MA, Tfouni SAV · 2021</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/oliveira2021-cocoa-beans-cd-pb-brazil-processing">Cd and Pb in cocoa beans: Occurrence and effects of chocolate processing</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Control 119, 107455</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/oliveira2021-cocoa-beans-cd-pb-brazil-processing">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="how-much-does-chocolate-add-to-childrens-exposure" data-anchor="how-much-does-chocolate-add-to-childrens-exposure" data-question="How much does chocolate add to children’s exposure?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>How much does chocolate add to children’s exposure?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

For European school-age children, chocolate and cocoa products together supplied close to 10% of cadmium exposure.<sup class="cite">[[sources/efsa2012-cadmium-dietary-exposure-europe|12]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Food Safety Authority · 2012</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/efsa2012-cadmium-dietary-exposure-europe">Cadmium dietary exposure in the European population</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">EFSA Journal 2012;10(1):2551</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/efsa2012-cadmium-dietary-exposure-europe">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Chocolate also drove up to 31% of adolescents’ nickel exposure.<sup class="cite">[[sources/efsa-nickel-contam-2020|40]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">EFSA Panel on Contaminants in the Food Chain (CONTAM) · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/efsa-nickel-contam-2020">Update of the Risk Assessment of Nickel in Food and Drinking Water</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">EFSA Journal 2020;18(11):6268</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/efsa-nickel-contam-2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="why-does-dark-chocolate-have-more-cadmium-than-milk-chocolate" data-anchor="why-does-dark-chocolate-have-more-cadmium-than-milk-chocolate" data-question="Why does dark chocolate have more cadmium than milk chocolate?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Why does dark chocolate have more cadmium than milk chocolate?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Cadmium sits in the nonfat cocoa solids, so it rises with cocoa content.<sup class="cite">[[sources/oliveira2021-cocoa-beans-cd-pb-brazil-processing|10]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ferreira de Oliveira AP, Milani RF, Efraim P, Morgano MA, Tfouni SAV · 2021</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/oliveira2021-cocoa-beans-cd-pb-brazil-processing">Cd and Pb in cocoa beans: Occurrence and effects of chocolate processing</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Control 119, 107455</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/oliveira2021-cocoa-beans-cd-pb-brazil-processing">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> In Japan, the median rose from 23 µg/kg below 50% cocoa to 250 µg/kg at 80% or more.<sup class="cite">[[sources/kataoka2018-japan-chocolate-cocoa-cadmium|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Kataoka Y, Watanabe T, Hayashi K, Akiyama H · 2018</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/kataoka2018-japan-chocolate-cocoa-cadmium">Surveillance of Cadmium Concentration in Chocolate and Cocoa Powder Products Distributed in Japan</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Hygiene and Safety Science</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/kataoka2018-japan-chocolate-cocoa-cadmium">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="is-the-lead-in-chocolate-from-the-soil" data-anchor="is-the-lead-in-chocolate-from-the-soil" data-question="Is the lead in chocolate from the soil?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Is the lead in chocolate from the soil?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Mostly not: lead is concentrated on the shell and in dust, and one investigation attributed about 70% of nib lead to contact during bean breaking and winnowing.<sup class="cite">[[sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahn, Timothy, Chaney, Rufus L., DiBartolomeis, Michael J., Ramtahal, Gideon · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Expert Investigation Related to Cocoa and Chocolate Products: Final Report</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Expert Committee report submitted to As You Sow and the Settling Defendants under a California Proposition 65 Consent Judgment; Project Manager: Eastern Research Group, Inc. (ERG). Final Report dated March 28, 2022 (381 pp., including three technical attachments).</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Industry shell lead had a median of 341 µg/kg against 1.2 µg/kg in nibs.<sup class="cite">[[sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahn, Timothy, Chaney, Rufus L., DiBartolomeis, Michael J., Ramtahal, Gideon · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Expert Investigation Related to Cocoa and Chocolate Products: Final Report</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Expert Committee report submitted to As You Sow and the Settling Defendants under a California Proposition 65 Consent Judgment; Project Manager: Eastern Research Group, Inc. (ERG). Final Report dated March 28, 2022 (381 pp., including three technical attachments).</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/asyousow2022-expert-investigation-cocoa-chocolate-products">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="has-lead-or-cadmium-in-chocolate-been-falling" data-anchor="has-lead-or-cadmium-in-chocolate-been-falling" data-question="Has lead or cadmium in chocolate been falling?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Has lead or cadmium in chocolate been falling?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

In a US analysis of products bought in 2014 to 2022, lead was lower in the 2019 and 2022 cohorts than in 2014, and cadmium was lower in 2022.<sup class="cite">[[sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa|26]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Hands JM, Anderson ML, Cooperman T, Balsky JE, Frame LA · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa">A multi-year heavy metal analysis of 72 dark chocolate and cocoa products in the USA</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Frontiers in Nutrition</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> The cohorts were different products chosen by popularity, so this is not a market-wide trend.<sup class="cite">[[sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa|26]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Hands JM, Anderson ML, Cooperman T, Balsky JE, Frame LA · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa">A multi-year heavy metal analysis of 72 dark chocolate and cocoa products in the USA</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Frontiers in Nutrition</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="does-cocoa-contain-nickel" data-anchor="does-cocoa-contain-nickel" data-question="Does cocoa contain nickel?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Does cocoa contain nickel?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Yes, at levels high for food: about 9,500 µg/kg in cocoa beans and products and 3,800 µg/kg in chocolate in European monitoring.<sup class="cite">[[sources/efsa2015-nickel-food-water|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">EFSA Panel on Contaminants in the Food Chain (CONTAM) · 2015</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/efsa2015-nickel-food-water">Scientific Opinion on the risks to public health related to the presence of nickel in food and drinking water</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">EFSA Journal 2015;13(2):4002, 202 pp.</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/efsa2015-nickel-food-water">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> The EU has limited nickel since July 2025 at 2.5 to 7.0 mg/kg in chocolate and 15 mg/kg in cocoa powder.<sup class="cite">[[sources/eu-2024-1987-nickel-maximum-levels|27]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Commission · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/eu-2024-1987-nickel-maximum-levels">Commission Regulation (EU) 2024/1987 of 30 July 2024 amending Regulation (EU) 2023/915 as regards maximum levels of nickel in certain foodstuffs</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Official Journal of the European Union, L series, 2024/1987 (31.7.2024)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/eu-2024-1987-nickel-maximum-levels">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="does-cocoa-contain-arsenic-or-mercury" data-anchor="does-cocoa-contain-arsenic-or-mercury" data-question="Does cocoa contain arsenic or mercury?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Does cocoa contain arsenic or mercury?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Usually little: FDA cocoa powder held 29 µg/kg total arsenic and 15 µg/kg mercury, and most European inorganic-arsenic results were below about 20 µg/kg.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|5]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|14]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> A US analysis reported a median of 50 µg/kg total arsenic in dark chocolate and cocoa products.<sup class="cite">[[sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa|26]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Hands JM, Anderson ML, Cooperman T, Balsky JE, Frame LA · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa">A multi-year heavy metal analysis of 72 dark chocolate and cocoa products in the USA</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Frontiers in Nutrition</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/hands2024-multiyear-dark-chocolate-cocoa-usa">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="is-bean-to-bar-chocolate-different" data-anchor="is-bean-to-bar-chocolate-different" data-question="Is bean-to-bar chocolate different?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Is bean-to-bar chocolate different?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Not clearly: Brazilian bean-to-bar dark chocolates averaged 78 µg/kg cadmium and 13 µg/kg lead, and bean-to-bar milk chocolates 25 and 12 µg/kg, in the same range as the few conventional bars tested alongside them.<sup class="cite">[[sources/burgon2023-cocoa-bean-to-bar-brazil-metals-ota|42]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Burgon VH · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/burgon2023-cocoa-bean-to-bar-brazil-metals-ota">Cacau e Chocolates &quot;Bean to Bar&quot;: Contaminantes Inorgânicos e Ocratoxina A (Cocoa beans and &quot;Bean to Bar&quot; chocolates: Inorganic contaminants and Ochratoxin A)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Master&#39;s thesis, Instituto de Tecnologia de Alimentos (ITAL), Centro de Ciência e Qualidade de Alimentos, Campinas-SP, Brazil</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/burgon2023-cocoa-bean-to-bar-brazil-metals-ota">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Artisanal Colombian single-farm bars made from high-cadmium beans averaged 1,100 µg/kg cadmium.<sup class="cite">[[sources/bravo2024-cadmium-cacao-arauca|43]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Bravo AG, Espinosa LF, Quiroga JA, Noriega RD, Castellanos DA · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/bravo2024-cadmium-cacao-arauca">Cadmium in cacao crops and artisanal chocolates in the Arauca Department, Colombia</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Environmental Monitoring and Assessment</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/bravo2024-cadmium-cacao-arauca">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>
